checks.name: contracts_payment_terms_check
checks.expression: (payment_terms IS NULL) OR CASE (payment_terms ->> 'kind'::text) WHEN 'net'::text THEN CASE WHEN (jsonb_typeof((payment_terms -> 'days'::text)) = 'number'::text) THEN ((((payment_terms ->> 'days'::text))::numeric >= (0)::numeric) AND (((payment_terms ->> 'days'::text))::numeric <= (365)::numeric)) ELSE false END WHEN 'end_of_month'::text THEN CASE WHEN (jsonb_typeof((payment_terms -> 'days'::text)) = 'number'::text) THEN ((((payment_terms ->> 'days'::text))::numeric >= (0)::numeric) AND (((payment_terms ->> 'days'::text))::numeric <= (365)::numeric)) ELSE false END WHEN 'day_of_next_month'::text THEN CASE WHEN (jsonb_typeof((payment_terms -> 'day'::text)) = 'number'::text) THEN ((((payment_terms ->> 'day'::text))::numeric >= (1)::numeric) AND (((payment_terms ->> 'day'::text))::numeric <= (31)::numeric)) ELSE false END ELSE false END

checks.name: prices_cap_minimum_check
checks.expression: "cap_amount" IS NULL OR "minimum_amount" IS NULL OR "cap_amount" >= "minimum_amount"

checks.name: prices_contract_owner_check
checks.expression: ("owner" = 'contract' AND "contract_id" IS NOT NULL) OR ("owner" = 'catalog' AND "contract_id" IS NULL)
